Name: Hold To Break Geodes
Author: CatCattyCat
TagLine: This mod lets you hold your mouse/controller down to continuously break open geodes - you don't have to click every time! Compatible with Fast Animations!
Description:
Hold to Break Geodes

This mod lets you hold your mouse/controller down to continuously break open geodes - you don't have to click every time! It is compatible with (and especially useful with) [Fast Animations](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1089/?)!

Simply hold your mouse/controller when you go to break open a geode and Clint will keep breaking geodes open as long as you have geodes of the same type to break.

This mod requires [SMAPI](https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases) by Pathoschild. To install, place the HoldToBreakGeodes folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

[Check out my other mods by clicking here!](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files)
